In a major step toward modernizing urban public transport, the much-awaited Trackless Tram has officially arrived in Lahore! Announced as a flagship initiative by Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz, this modern, eco-friendly transit system operates without traditional steel railway tracks, using virtual optical guidance and rubber tires on dedicated road lanes.

Designed to ease daily commuting congestion, reduce air pollution, and provide affordable, comfortable travel for thousands of citizens, the trackless tram marks a new era for Lahore's mass transit network alongside electric buses and the Orange Line Metro. snippet.title: What If Naruto Could Copy Any Jutsu After Seeing It Once and Was 1000x Smarter?
snippet.description:
What if Naruto could copy any jutsu after seeing it once, and his mind was 1000x faster than anyone in the world? On a frozen lake, seven-year-old Naruto is drowning. Kurama's chakra floods into his brain, and he wakes up with a gift no one in Konoha has: one look at any jutsu, and it is his forever, stored on a shelf in a giant library inside his mind.

In the bell test he copies Kakashi's Chidori in one look, and in nine minutes he throws forty of Kakashi's own jutsu back at him. He reads the Forbidden Scroll in twelve seconds, rebuilds Haku's ice bloodline with pure brainpower, beats Neji with the Hyuga's own Rotation, and undoes Edo Tensei to save the Third Hokage. But the power has rules: for one hour he copies the person too (Gai's "Youth!" and even Kiba's "Woof"), his body is still a kid with kid chakra, and he can't copy anything while he is crying.

Then he meets Itachi, and for the first time a jutsu refuses to be copied. At the Valley of the End the masked man uses Kamui, and Naruto learns some things are not jutsu at all, they are eyes. A full Naruto What If story with Kurama, Kakashi, Sasuke, Sakura, Jiraiya, Haku, Zabuza, Neji, Hinata, Gaara, Itachi, Tsunade and Danzo, ending with a red spiral cliffhanger.

Poll Films imzalı Tuzlu Kahve dizisi her Salı 20.00'de Star'da!

Dizi Özeti;
İstanbul’un köklü ve varlıklı ailelerinden birinin torunu olan Derin, hayatını belirli bir plana göre yaşamaya çalışan, evlenip yuva kurmayı en büyük hedefi haline getirmiş genç bir kadındır. Ancak uzun süredir devam eden ilişkisine rağmen bir türlü gerçekleşmeyen düğün hazırlıkları ve ailesinin bitmek bilmeyen beklentileri, onu her geçen gün daha fazla baskı altına almaktadır. Diğer tarafta ise yıllardır yurt dışında yaşayan Mehmet, ailevi sebeplerle Türkiye’ye döner. Başarılı, kendi ayakları üzerinde duran ve hayatını alıştığı düzende sürdürmek isteyen Mehmet’in dönüşü, ailesi için yeni umutların başlangıcı olur. Özellikle annesi, oğlunun artık ülkesine, ailesine ve kuracağı yeni hayata bağlanmasını istemektedir. Bunun için oğluna bir gelin adayı bile bulmuştur. Tam bu dönemde Mehmet’in kardeşi Murat’ın evlilik hazırlıkları, Derin’in hayatında hiç beklemediği kapıları aralar. Murat’ın nişanlısı ve ailesiyle, Derin arasında geçmişe dayanan gerilimler, iki ailenin yollarını kesiştirirken, yıllardır gizli kalmış duyguların ve hesapların da yeniden gündeme gelmesine neden olur. Bambaşka dünyalara ait gibi görünen Mehmet ve Derin’in yolları, ailelerin beklentileri, geçmişten gelen yükler, sırlar, yanlış anlaşılmalar ve sürpriz karşılaşmalar eşliğinde kesişmeye başlar.

Tuzlu Kahve, aşkın sadece iki insan arasında değil, aileler, gelenekler ve hayatın dayattığı beklentiler arasında da sınandığı; romantik komedi ile aile dramasını iç içe geçiren sıcak, eğlenceli ve duygusal bir hikâye anlatmaktadır.

Around the new Navi Mumbai airport, property prices in Dronagiri jumped 41.9%. Panvel, 26%. Kharghar, 20%.

Almost every airline that tried to make money flying between India's smaller cities has failed.

But it lost ₹130 crore in a single year and shut down in 2017!!

snippet.description:
Roger Love is a world-renowned vocal coach and the creator of VQ, his approach to vocal intelligence. He began coaching at just 16, working with groups including The Beach Boys and The Jacksons. Since then, he has built a career helping people use their voices more effectively in both speaking and singing. 

His clients include singers such as Selena Gomez and John Mayer, actors such as Bradley Cooper and Reese Witherspoon, and speakers such as Tony Robbins. Love has also coached actors for films including Walk the Line and Crazy Heart, helping them shape their voices for the screen.

Love is also an author and the creator of voice-training programs including Vocal Power and The Perfect Voice. His work focuses on how vocal technique can help people communicate with greater clarity, confidence and connection whether they’re performing on stage, speaking at work or having an everyday conversation.

In This Episode, Roger Love explains how the chest, middle and head voice work together to create a balanced, confident and expressive speaking voice.
